about.title: Who I am, in one paragraph
about.manifesto: Six-plus years building production software for banking, legal, and energy: from Spain's leading legal marketplace to Big Data platforms in the energy sector, and today the backend architecture at Andbank. I have led complex migrations, integrated legacy systems, and designed hexagonal and microservices architectures. Outside work, I build: eight products of my own — from a platform for writers to a VERI*FACTU invoicing system — with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, and MCP workflows, deployed on my own VPS, Vercel, and Google Cloud.

duration.yearsMonths: {years, plural, one {# year} other {# years}} and {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}

andbank-2024.summary: Backend architecture and technical management in private banking: development standards, core-systems integration, and evaluation of AI solutions.
highlights: Designed backend architecture (Java 21, Spring Boot 3) under Clean Architecture and hexagonal principles; new homebanking with 15+ components.
Led the Spring Boot 2 → 3 migration (Jakarta namespace) and Tomcat 7/8 → 9/10 across 40+ VMs.
Integrated legacy systems (COBOL, AS400, DB2), evolved shipping-carrier integration APIs, and rolled out Keycloak with MFA and per-jurisdiction rules.
Code quality: SonarQube integrated across every repository, including analysis of 12,000+ COBOL files.
AI adoption in the department: rolled out Gemini Code Assist for the whole team.
Managed vendors technically, drove build-vs-buy decisions, and controlled technical debt on OpenShift (OCP4).

elabogado-2022.summary: Full-stack development and platform modernization at Spain's leading legal marketplace.
highlights: Modernized legacy code: migrated Struts2 to React + Spring Boot.
Designed microservices and secure REST APIs.
Improved performance, maintainability, and architecture evolution.
Content and landing-page management with WordPress.
Built microservices with Java and Spring Boot for distributed systems.
Designed and documented APIs with Swagger / OpenAPI.
Distributed teamwork with Jira, Confluence and Slack.

keapps-2020.summary: Kronos project (Endesa): enterprise Java systems and Big Data solutions.
highlights: Big Data solutions with Hadoop, Spark and Cassandra over energy-consumption data.
MapReduce jobs on HDFS/YARN and optimization of critical batch processes.

ayesa-2019.summary: Kronos project (Endesa): Java development and data pipelines.
highlights: Developed and maintained enterprise Java systems (SOAP, XML) with JSP and PrimeFaces interfaces.
Large-scale data pipelines with MapReduce and S3 storage.

projects.title: Selected projects
projects.hint: {count, plural, one {# project} other {# projects}} · AI-built

othertales.name: Other Tales
othertales.summary: All-in-one platform for writers: Flutter app with offline writing and a Java 21 / Spring Boot 3.5 backend in hexagonal architecture, dockerized and migrating to a self-hosted VPS.
highlights: Offline-first app: Riverpod, GoRouter and a local Drift/SQLite store with sync.
Hexagonal backend with OAuth2/JWT (Supabase Auth), Flyway and Redis.
Dockerized; deployment migrating from Cloud Run to a self-hosted VPS (netcup).

trasolido.name: Trasolido
trasolido.summary: VERI*FACTU-compliant invoicing with a powerful backend: modular Java 21 / Spring Boot monolith with its own JWT auth, event streaming over Redis (Upstash) and PostgreSQL on Neon. React frontend and AI data extraction.
highlights: VERI*FACTU regulatory compliance with full traceability.
Own JWT authentication and event streaming over Upstash Redis.
PostgreSQL on Neon · backend on Google Cloud Run · frontend on Vercel.

porrix.name: PRONOQ
porrix.summary: Football prediction pool with friends: mobile-first PWA for LaLiga and Champions with live scores, automatic standings and AI result analysis. In Spanish, English and Catalan.
highlights: Live score tracking and automatic standings.
AI explains results: it narrates stats, never recommends predictions.
On a self-hosted VPS: web + worker in Docker containers; performance budgets that block PRs.

corte1d.name: Corte1D
corte1d.summary: Workshop SaaS: imports cut lists from Excel/CSV, optimizes 1D cutting with a deterministic engine and tracks stock. PWA with PDF export.
highlights: Pure, deterministic cutting engine with canonical units.
Imports from Excel, CSV and SolidWorks; files stored in Backblaze B2.
Own secure login (Argon2), built with Agent OS: specialized AI agents per role.

tavory.name: Tavory
tavory.summary: Private gastronomy memory: log what you tried, where, and whether you'd go back. AI-powered OCR for instant capture, Mapbox maps and a Stripe-powered Plus tier.
highlights: Supabase: Auth, PostgreSQL + PostGIS, Storage and RLS.
AI OCR with a strict JSON contract, always with a manual fallback.
Stripe Checkout and Customer Portal; deployed on Vercel.

contactqr.name: Contact QR
contactqr.summary: Digital contact card: a QR code that adds your details (vCard) straight to the phone's contacts.
highlights: Instant vCard via QR code.
Lightweight site built with Astro.

portfolio.name: This portfolio
portfolio.summary: The very site you are reading: a type-safe Next.js + tRPC + Zod stack with bilingual routing, an interactive terminal, a command palette, and a PDF CV generated from the same data you see on screen.
highlights: Type-safe Next.js + tRPC + Zod stack with bilingual routing.
Interactive terminal and ⌘K command palette for navigation.
Server-generated PDF CV from a single source of truth.
Purposeful motion that never blocks content or shifts layout.
